title: VoltPilot v2 Flow Artifact / Deployment
description: The DEPLOYABLE compiled form of a flow (compiler input = flow-graph.schema.json) and the retained deployment payload that rolls artifacts out to an edge device. Two message kinds (oneOf): 'artifact' = one compiled flow (manifest + compiled Node-RED tab bundle); 'deployment' = the DESIRED-STATE SET of active artifacts for one device, published RETAINED QoS1 on ems/{tenant_id}/{site_id}/{device_id}/v2/flows (the proven retained-config self-wiring pattern: edge/inverter/config, edge/sources/config, provisioning). The edge core consumes the deployment, verifies each artifact's content_hash and version gates, persists it, injects the tabs into the Node-RED runtime, and acknowledges per artifact in the status heartbeat's additive 'flows' block (flow-artifact.md). Rollback = the cloud republishes the deployment with the previous artifact - the retained topic always carries the full desired state, never a diff. schema_version starts at 1.0 (brand-new contract).
x-topic: ems/{tenant_id}/{site_id}/{device_id}/v2/flows  (Cloud -> Edge, QoS1, retained; deployment kind only)
x-limits: One serialized artifact <= 262144 bytes (256 KiB); one deployment <= 524288 bytes (512 KiB) - comfortably under EMQX's default 1 MiB max packet. The cloud compiler enforces both; a flow whose compiled bundle exceeds the budget fails activation with a clear error. An out-of-band fetch channel (hash + HTTPS download via the enrollment-style API) is the documented escape hatch if real flows ever outgrow this - not built in v1.

runtime.description: v1 rollout channel below applies to 'edge'; cloud artifacts deploy inside the cloud runner (E12), never over MQTT.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical serialization of the 'bundle' object. The edge re-canonicalizes and verifies before applying; a mismatch is acked as state 'error' and never deployed.

min_palette_version.description: Minimum @voltpilot/node-red-vp-palette version the bundle's nodes require. The edge compares against its installed palette and refuses (ack state 'unsupported') instead of deploying a bundle its runtime cannot execute.

min_core_version.description: Minimum vp-edge-core version required (e.g. for arbitration features the flow relies on). Same refusal semantics as min_palette_version.

required_entities.description: The entities and capabilities this flow needs. The edge checks them against its entity registry view at deploy time; missing entities/capabilities => ack state 'unsupported' with detail (the flow is NOT partially deployed).

items.description: Capability descriptor: measure:<channel> (e.g. measure:power_kw) or actuate:<command> (e.g. actuate:setpoint_kw, the edge-desired vocabulary).

bundle.description: The compiled runtime payload. v1 format: the Node-RED node array for this flow's tab(s), generated exclusively from catalog node implementations (vp-palette nodes + generated wiring - NO function nodes with free code in user flows). Tabs carry the ownership marker (flow-artifact.md §tab-ownership) so the reseed mechanism can tell artifact tabs from vendor template tabs.

tab_ids.description: Ids of the tab nodes contained in nodered_flows; deterministic per (flow_id, flow_version) so redeploys replace instead of duplicating.

nodered_flows.description: The Node-RED node objects (including the tab node(s)), exactly as they will appear in the runtime's flow configuration.

signature.description: RESERVED for artifact signing at activation (plan §2.2 'signiertes Artefakt'). Format and trust chain are an E2 deliverable; edges tolerate the field's absence until then.

deployment.title: Retained deployment set for one device

device_id.description: MUST match the topic path (the v1 topic==payload identity rule).

artifacts.description: The COMPLETE desired set of active flow artifacts for this device (runtime 'edge' only). An empty array clears all artifact tabs (every user flow released; entities fall to lower-priority desires / failsafes). An artifact present in the previous deployment but absent here is undeployed. At most one artifact per flow_id.
